  "domain_file": "(define (domain blocksworld-fragile)
  (:requirements :strips :negative-preconditions)
  (:predicates
    (on ?x ?y)                ; ?x is on ?y
    (on-table ?x)            ; ?x is directly on the table
    (clear ?x)               ; nothing is on top of ?x
    (holding ?x)             ; the robot arm is holding ?x
    (arm-empty)              ; the robot arm is empty
    (fragile ?x)             ; ?x is fragile (no block may be placed on it)
  )
  ;------------------------------------------------------------
  ; Action: pick up a clear block from the table
  (:action pickup
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b)
                 (not (on-table ?b))
                 (not (clear ?b))
                 (not (arm-empty))
               )
  )
  ;------------------------------------------------------------
  ; Action: put down a held block onto the table
  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (holding ?b)
    :effect (and (on-table ?b)
                 (clear ?b)
                 (arm-empty)
                 (not (holding ?b))
               )
  )
  ;------------------------------------------------------------
  ; Action: stack a held block onto a clear, non‑fragile block
  (:action stack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c) (not (fragile ?c)))
    :effect (and (on ?b ?c)
                 (clear ?b)
                 (arm-empty)
                 (not (holding ?b))
                 (not (clear ?c))

  )
  ;------------------------------------------------------------
  ; Action: unstack a clear block from another block
  (:action unstack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b)
                 (clear ?c)
                 (not (on ?b ?c))
                 (not (clear ?b))
                 (not (arm-empty))
               )
  )
)

  "domain_file": "(define (domain blocksworld)
  (:requirements :strips)
  ; Predicates for block relationships and arm status
  (:predicates
    (on ?x ?y)          ; ?x is on ?y
    (on-table ?x)      ; ?x is on the table
    (clear ?x)         ; nothing on top of ?x
    (holding ?x)       ; arm is holding ?x
    (arm-empty)        ; arm is empty
    (blocked ?x)       ; ?x has been put down on table and cannot be picked up again
  )

  ; Pickup a clear block from the table (only if it hasn't been blocked)
  (:action pickup
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (and (clear ?b) (on-table ?b) (arm-empty) (not (blocked ?b)))
    :effect (and (holding ?b)
                 (not (on-table ?b))
                 (not (clear ?b))
                 (not (arm-empty)))
  )

  ; Put down a held block onto the table; after this it becomes blocked
  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (holding ?b)
    :effect (and (on-table ?b)
                 (clear ?b)
                 (arm-empty)
                 (not (holding ?b))
                 (blocked ?b))
  )

  ; Stack a held block onto a clear block
  (:action stack
